_chapters.第二章 数据安全与发展: Chapter II  Data Security and Development
_chapters.第三章 数据安全制度: Chapter III  The Data Security System
_chapters.第四章 数据安全保护义务: Chapter IV  Data Security Protection Obligations
_chapters.第五章 政务数据安全与开放: Chapter V  Security and Openness of Government Data

第一条: Article 1  This Law is formulated in order to standardise data processing activities, to safeguard data security, to promote the development and use of data, to protect the lawful rights and interests of individuals and organisations, and to safeguard national sovereignty, security and development interests.
第二条:
Article 2  This Law applies to data processing activities carried out within the territory of the People’s Republic of China and to the security supervision of such activities.

Where data processing activities carried out outside the territory of the People’s Republic of China harm the national security or the public interest of the People’s Republic of China, or the lawful rights and interests of its citizens or organisations, legal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law.
第三条:
Article 3  “Data” in this Law means any record of information by electronic or other means.

“Data processing” includes the collection, storage, use, handling, transmission, provision and disclosure of data.

“Data security” means ensuring, through the adoption of necessary measures, that data is in a state of effective protection and lawful use, and having the capacity to safeguard that state of security on a continuing basis.
第四条: Article 4  In safeguarding data security, the overall national security concept shall be upheld, a sound data security governance system shall be established, and the capacity to assure data security shall be raised.
第五条: Article 5  The central leading body for national security is responsible for decision-making and deliberative coordination of national data security work; it researches and formulates, and guides the implementation of, the national data security strategy and related major guidelines and policies, provides overall coordination of major matters and important work concerning national data security, and establishes a national data security work coordination mechanism.
第六条:
Article 6  Each region and each department is responsible for the data it collects and generates in the course of its work in that region or department, and for the security of that data.

The competent departments for industry, telecommunications, transport, finance, natural resources, health, education, science and technology and other fields undertake data security supervision duties for their own industry or field.

Public security organs and state security organs undertake data security supervision duties within the scope of their respective responsibilities, in accordance with this Law and the relevant laws and administrative regulations.

The national cyberspace administration department is responsible for the overall coordination of network data security and the related supervision work, in accordance with this Law and the relevant laws and administrative regulations.
第七条: Article 7  The State protects the data-related rights and interests of individuals and organisations, encourages the lawful, reasonable and effective use of data, ensures the lawful, orderly and free flow of data, and promotes the development of a digital economy with data as a key factor.
第八条: Article 8  In carrying out data processing activities, a party shall comply with laws and regulations, respect social morality and ethics, observe commercial and professional ethics, be honest and trustworthy, perform data security protection obligations and bear social responsibility; it may not endanger national security or the public interest, nor harm the lawful rights and interests of individuals or organisations.
第九条: Article 9  The State supports publicity and popularisation of data security knowledge, raises society-wide awareness and capability in data security protection, and encourages the relevant departments, industry organisations, research institutions, enterprises and individuals to participate jointly in data security protection work, so as to create a sound environment in which the whole of society safeguards data security and promotes development.
第十条: Article 10  The relevant industry organisations shall, in accordance with their articles of association, formulate codes of conduct and group standards for data security in accordance with law, strengthen industry self-regulation, guide their members in strengthening data security protection, raise the level of data security protection, and promote the healthy development of the industry.
第十一条: Article 11  The State shall actively conduct international exchange and cooperation in fields such as data security governance and the development and use of data, participate in the formulation of international rules and standards relating to data security, and promote the secure and free cross-border flow of data.
第十二条:
Article 12  Any individual or organisation has the right to complain or report to the competent authorities concerning conduct in violation of this Law. The department receiving a complaint or report shall deal with it promptly in accordance with law.

The competent authorities shall keep confidential the relevant information of the complainant or person making the report, and shall protect their lawful rights and interests.
